description: This file defines the class TableOfContentsRenderer, which implements the NodeRendererInterface to render a table of contents in Markdown content within an OpenCart-related project. It utilizes external libraries such as League CommonMark for Markdown rendering and includes project-specific configurations.

classes.name: TableOfContentsRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class that converts a Markdown table of contents node into HTML using project-specific templates and external rendering engines.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the renderer with project configuration and sets up a list block renderer.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Method that verifies the node type, renders the content with the parent ListBlockRenderer, and then applies a template to produce HTML output.
